title: Assemblr unit manifest
description: Editor assistance for manifest.jsonc. Assemblr's own validation is authoritative: rules a schema cannot express, such as cross-field consistency, are still enforced by Assemblr. This file is written by `assemblr unit init`; run it again after upgrading Assemblr to refresh it.

$schema.description: Points editors at this schema. Editor support only.

name.description: The unit's identity, `@owner/unit-name`: lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and single hyphens between them, in each segment.

version.description: The unit's exact SemVer version. Publication tags it as `v<version>`.

description.description: A human-readable description of the unit.

dependencies.description: The units this unit composes, by identity, each with a SemVer requirement such as `^1.2`.

additionalProperties.description: A SemVer requirement, such as `^1.2`, `~1.4`, or `=2.0.0`.

options.description: Values this unit requires for the parameters of its direct dependencies, by dependency identity.

additionalProperties.description: The required values, by parameter name.

params.description: The unit's public configuration parameters, by name.

amendments.description: The unit's amendments, by the amended file's path in the provider's `src/`, which is the copy's path under `amendments/`.

parameter.description: A parameter definition. A parameter without a default is required from consumers.

default.description: The value used when a consumer supplies none. Its presence makes the parameter optional.

example.description: A value this unit is built, checked, and published with while the parameter is required and has no default. It is not a default: a consumer must still supply the parameter, and the example is never used as its value.

allowed.description: The values a string parameter accepts, which makes it an enumerated string. Only with `"type": "string"`.

mapping.description: Requires the dependency's parameter to have the value of one of this unit's own parameters, as it is decided for the composition. Nothing is converted.

amendment.description: The provenance of an amendment copy.

unit.description: The direct dependency that provides the amended file.

base.description: The exact version of that dependency the copy was taken from: its locked version.
